scene: The cabinet opens into a hidden transit nexus.
picture: Along a polished concourse floor, the player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre. On the left, a river barge sits at an open dock arch. At the centre stands an ornate brass spiral lift. At the right, a red mountain cable tram rests on shining tracks, ready for passengers.
shown: a low river barge moored at a dock door on the left
a brass spiral lift with an open gate at the centre
a red mountain cable tram waiting on tracks at the right
